description_en: Modifies the name or description of a route table, or specifies whether to receive dynamic routes
description_zh: 修改路由表的名称、描述，或者修改是否接收动态路由
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-route-table-attributes --route-table-id vtb-bp145q7glnuzdvzu20000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRouteTableAttributes

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the route table.  

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由表的名称。  

名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: route_table_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the route table.  

The description must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由表的描述信息。  

描述长度为1～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route table belongs. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由表所属的VPC的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to receive dynamic routes by enabling or disabling route propagation. Valid values:

true (default): enabled.
false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
您可以通过开启或者关闭传播路由来控制是否接收动态路由。取值：

true（默认值）：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: route_propagation_enable
